title: Webflow initialization definition
description: The init definition describes items such as pre-conditions for the flow, initial state and handler for extracting instance arguments.

state.description: Definition The starting state for an instance of the flow.

handler.description: Coldbox handler that will return initial state in a struct.

args.description: Hardcoded properties that will be returned as instance args

configform.description: Preside form ID that will be used to configure initial state for an instance of this flow. (i.e. an admin user will use this form to configure a specific instance of the flow)

instanceargs.description: Definition of unique set of args that will identify an instance of this flow. These can be generated from a handler or hardcoded as a set of args here.

handler.description: Coldbox handler that will return instance args in a struct. It will be passed initialState struct with any initial state.

args.description: Hardcoded properties that will be returned as instance args

condition.description: CFFlow condition that must evaluate true in order for the flow to be able to be instantiated / worked through.
